target_customer: Healthcare organizations, telehealth companies and health plans that must credential and monitor providers
problem: Verifying a clinician's licenses and credentials is mostly manual and takes weeks. Verifiable offers an API and later software and CVO services that automate primary source verification.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API usage plus credentialing verification organization (CVO) services
product_category: Healthcare provider credentialing and network monitoring software

founders.name: Nick Macario
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (2020-10-20) says his experience verifying employee credentials at Remote.com led to Verifiable.

founders.name: Vivekanand Rajkumar
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CTO by TechCrunch; YC page lists him as Viv Rajkumar.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to hundreds of primary sources (state boards, registries) with reliable real-time data is mostly integration and data-quality work, with NCQA and SOC 2 standards later.

defensibility.rationale: Source integrations and compliance certifications take time to build and customers embed the API, but integrations are copyable by funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. A 2026 Assured funding article names Verifiable among credentialing vendors that still rely on people, showing newer AI-native rivals.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2020-10) describes healthcare credential verification as largely manual, and telehealth demand in 2020 pushed Talkspace, Sesame and Verge Health to use the API, covering over 50,000 providers.

branding.domain_note: Uses verifiable.com (exact common-word .com); acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a generic term shared with the W3C 'verifiable credentials' concept, so searches mix with unrelated identity topics. Customer logos and NCQA certification, not the brand, carry trust.

pivots.to: Provider network management and credentialing software plus NCQA-certified CVO services, later an AI agent (CredAgent)
pivots.why: Moved up from an API toward full credentialing workflows; the company site now leads with CredAgent. Exact pivot dates not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Verifiable raised a $3M seed in October 2020 from well-known angels and funds, then a $27M Series B in July 2023 led by Craft Ventures. It expanded from an API into credentialing software and CVO services with large payer customers such as Humana. No shutdown or acquisition was found, and newer AI-native credentialing startups are now rivals.
notes: Search summaries say a Series A of about $17M in 2021 (Struck Capital, The Altman Fund) and a total near $47M, but no opened source confirms them, so no Series A round is recorded; the gap is noted. Company's Series B post says Series B investors included The Altman Fund and Struck. YC page lists founders as Nick Macario (co-founder of DockNetwork and Remote) and Viv Rajkumar; education not found. Competitors: neither TechCrunch (2020) nor company pages name rivals, and the competitor items found (CredSimple, CertifyOS, Medallion) were undated or from 2022 or later, so the list is empty. YC page puts the company in San Francisco while press says Austin.
